name: Alva
headline: Turn Telenor’s usage data into customers who stay.
saw: Your homepage speaks to investors, media and job seekers in the same navigation, and carries a business segment and promotions alongside them. Every visitor sees the same front page, whatever they came for.

The strongest signal you own sits in your customers’ usage: data consumption, top-ups, plan changes and the business accounts that start buying or go quiet. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns for each product line are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Catch the customer before they leave
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from usage drops, top-up gaps and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Make every offer fit the customer
cases.text: Next best offer per customer, for mobile, broadband and business services, matched to what each one already uses. No more blanket campaigns to customers already on the right plan.

cases.head: Keep customers using their services weekly
cases.text: Personal nudges by email and web, based on the services each customer uses and the ones they have never tried, so every customer has a reason to come back.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
